entries.Move Konrad to the signpost in the north: Move Konrad to the signpost in the north-west
entries.Twenty years into her rule, Asheviere tu: Twenty years into her rule, Asheviere turned her attention to the wood elves living in the great forest south-west of Wesnoth, whom she despised. Orcish mercenaries were hired and dispatched to bring about their ruin.
entries.We will go north. Perhaps we can reach t: We will go north. Perhaps we can reach the Isle of Alduin. If we can make it there, surely we will be safe. Konrad, we must recruit some elves to help us, and then you must make it to the sign post in the north-west. I will protect you!
entries.Remember, it is rumored that the filthy: Remember, it is rumoured that the filthy mage and one that he protects are in these parts. They are the ones we want!
entries.The elves will fight. They may even prev: The elves will fight. They may even prevail. But I fear things do not bode well for them. Let us not speak of it now. Onwards!
entries.I... I don’t think I can make it anymore: I... I don’t think I can make it any more.
entries.Konrad, this is Kaylan, one of the might: Konrad, this is Kaylan, one of the mightiest of the horse lords, and one of the few who is willing to oppose the Dark Crown. Rumour has it that his lance has slain fifty men and a hundred orcs.
entries.It seems the orcs have come here too, to: It seems the orcs have come here too, to try to wrest this port from our hands. Our defences are still weak, but reinforcements will arrive soon!
entries.I will send one of my horsemen to serve: I will send one of my horsemen to serve under you. I offer you my support Konrad, and the support of my men — from now on you will be able to recruit horsemen.
entries.Reinforcements have arrived, but lo! Our: Reinforcements have arrived, but lo! Our allies have already destroyed the orcish army menacing our fair port. In honour, I must reward your valour.
entries.You have risked your life to defend our: You have risked your life to defend our city. In return, I place one of my city’s finest defenders in your service. Simyr, step forwards. I place your lance in the service of young Prince Konrad here. May you help him restore order to the country.
entries.It is my pleasure and honor to serve, my: It is my pleasure and honour to serve, my liege.
entries.She has taken control of the Bay of Pear: She has taken control of the Bay of Pearls, long held by the mer, and has turned them into slaves. There they dive for pearls by which she grows richer every day. There are even rumours that she may break the ancient treaty and attack Elensefar!
entries.Thank you for rescuing us! Now we can he: Thank you for rescuing us! Now we can help you fight the evil orcs! The main cage where they keep most of the merfolk is in the north-west!
entries.Victory is ours! Let us hope that this d: Victory is ours! Let us hope that this delay will not hamper our quest to save Elensefar, but at least we have freed these good people. We must move onwards with haste!
entries.Let’s hope these rumors are not true! I: Let’s hope these rumours are not true! I have none of my men or gold with me! How could I defend myself?
entries.There are some ancient temples to the so: There are some ancient temples to the south-west; I wonder what might be inside them!
entries.We will serve you well, for we respect t: We will serve you well, for we respect the help you are providing to our city. You shall find that there is honour, even among thieves.
entries.I have been meeting with the Ka’lian, th: I have been meeting the Ka’lian, the Great Council of the Elves. This is Kalenz, a great lord of the Northern Elves who came to the Council to offer us the support of his people.
entries.The Sceptre of Fire is the most ancient: The Sceptre of Fire is the most ancient artefact of the realm of Wesnoth. It was forged by the dwarves of Knalga at the request of King Haldric II. It took their finest smiths years to make it, but soon after it was completed, the makers were chased underground, attacked by the elves. None know exactly what occurred, but the Sceptre was lost somewhere in the great caverns. Years have passed, and the fortunes of the dwarves have waxed and waned, but the Sceptre has never been found.
So you endeavour to fight me in my home. Foolish.
entries.Here we come to the great cross-roads. W: Here we come to the great crossroads. We should go north-east.
entries.Victory is ours, men. Let us proceed nor: Victory is ours, men. Let us proceed north-east!
entries.It is both my duty and pleasure, my lord: It is both my duty and pleasure, my lord! We were dining with some royal guards of the Princess, taking a rest from our pilgrimage, when they spoke of how you were tricked into travelling these dangerous lands. We could do nothing but help you!
The land of Wesnoth is not safe for us. The Queen’s forces reach every corner. We must make haste to the Northlands, across the Great River. Let us go quickly!
entries.We must continue north. It is too late t: We must continue north. It is too late to return to the safety of Elensefar or Alduin before winter falls. We must therefore cross the great river and continue towards the land of the dwarves. Hurry, let us go!
entries.Amazing! I have never before heard of su: Amazing! I have never before heard of such behaviour in gryphons.
entries.It is a shame we could not get those gry: It is a shame we could not get those gryphon eggs — they would surely have given us an advantage some time. Still, we must continue.
entries.He did die in battle at my hand. It is s: He did die in battle at my hand. It is sad that your brothers did not have the opportunity to experience such an honourable death, Konrad.
entries.With all respect, my lords, we must make: With all respect, my lords, we must make haste. We have to ford the river immediately. And, look! It seems that the guard towers on the river banks are manned!
entries.It surely looks like she will try. But m: It surely looks like she will try. But many more creatures than we have fought lurk in this river; that will make it difficult for her. We must continue onwards. If she makes it across before winter, then so be it!
entries.Swirling, snow-laden winds tore at Konra: Swirling, snow-laden winds tore at Konrad’s army, signalling the final exit of autumn and the onset of what would be a harsh winter.
entries.We are pursued by the forces of your arc: We are pursued by the forces of your arch-enemy, chasing the Sceptre of Fire, the fate of the realm in our hands, and you humans want to stop and rest? Onwards, I say!
entries.They are right, Kalenz. I had wanted to: They are right, Kalenz. I had wanted to acquire the Sceptre within a moon, but it is not to be. Our soldiers will begin to desert if they do not rest soon. But in these wild Northlands, we must fight even for the right to rest. Look to the north! Those foul orcs will not allow us any peace!
entries.More snow is falling. We must finish thi: More snow is falling. We must finish this battle quickly. Onwards, men!
entries.The defense of the dwarves must have bee: The defence of the dwarves must have been strong. Look at those ruined towers!
entries.I would settle for escape, though I know: I would settle for escape, though I know not which I dread more: foul orcs or foetid caves.
entries.There is no time for idle chatter or del: There is no time for idle chatter or delay of any kind. Onwards!
entries.Indeed we must not delay. The mines in t: Indeed we must not delay. The mines in the north-east are the best way to enter.
entries.‘Never done us any harm?’ Why, I was the: ‘Never done us any harm?’ Why, I was there myself, when the elves refused to honour our alliance. Many dwarves were slaughtered, and you cowardly elves did nothing to help!
entries.You go too far! I am Kalenz, a mighty el: You go too far! I am Kalenz, a mighty elvish lord! How dare such as you, snivelling in his tunnel, call me a coward?
entries.You speak foolishness. No one even knows: You speak foolishness. No-one even knows if the Sceptre of Fire still exists. And who is this heir, this king that you speak of?
entries.You are right, friend. I will put my bes: You are right, friend. I will put my best men at your disposal, though we know nought of the Sceptre’s location. Legend says it is hidden in the eastern tunnels.
entries.I am sorry, Prince Konrad. The young gry: I am sorry, Prince Konrad. The young gryphons are breaking their ropes. They are simply getting too large and too restless to restrain any more!
Whoa there... No need to be surly, now. Easy... easy... now GO!
entries.I will rescue you. Hold onto my shoulder: I will rescue you. Hold on to my shoulders, sir dwarf.
entries.female^We must hurry to assist them, my: We must hurry to assist them, my lords.
entries.You emerge into a vast natural cathedral: You emerge into a vast natural cathedral, the walls arching higher than you can see in the darkness. Stretching across the gallery is a great chasm, around which the cave floor appears to have been completely worn smooth. This was once the centre of a bustling dwarvish empire, the remnants of which have since been driven into the upper caves of Knalga by the forces of darkness.
entries.And fine troops they are, Prince, but no: And fine troops they are, Prince, but no dwarf can match a guardsman’s resolute defence. Please accept the service o’ my clan’s defenders, to protect you and your quest.
entries.Northeast o’ my keep, Delfador, the tunn: North-east o’ my keep, Delfador, the tunnels converge towards the deepest reaches o’ the underground kingdom. The Sceptre can only be there.
entries.I do not know, Konrad, but I can sense o: I do not know, Konrad, but I can sense our path only leads us downwards. We will continue to the north-east, to the deepest depths of these caverns.
entries.The last dwarvish settlement far behind: The last dwarvish settlement far behind them, the party descended into the deepest parts of the hewn caverns. Except for disturbances caused by the occasional goblin, the air in the lower passages was still and tomb-like.
entries.Friends, peace! Though we are out of the: Friends, peace! Though we are out of the tunnels, we are hardly safe. We are somewhere in the arid and wild Northlands, that is all we know. Behold! To the north, orcs, to the south, dark hordes. We must remain at peace with one another, or else all perish!
entries.Prince Konrad, you need not avoid the Ar: Prince Konrad, you need not avoid the Arkan-thoria. We merfolk can lead you downstream; with our vanguard, your company will vanquish any foe, and reach the home of the North Elves much sooner than by either of the land routes. I cannot promise a perilless journey, but it is an option for you to consider, my lord.
entries.We are traveling east? Down the river? K: We are travelling east? Down the river? Konrad, I hope you know what you are committing us to.
entries.Who would discard such a wondrous artifa: Who would discard such a wondrous artefact?
entries.The Death Knight explodes into a cloud o: The Death Knight explodes into a cloud of dust as it is eradicated. Its armour, however, drops to the ground and remains intact. The heavy black steel is polished to a mirror shine.
entries.The party traveled down the river for da: The party travelled down the river for days, sometimes walking through the shallow water, sometimes swimming, helped by the merfolk.
entries.These are not proper ships, but shallow-: These are not proper ships, but shallow-draught boats built only recently; much of their timber is green. They were sunk in battle, not by a storm. Those that were not capsized have been burned. The battle must have taken place not long ago, perhaps only a few weeks past. We’ve found no survivors. One more thing... all flew the banner of the Crown of Wesnoth.
entries.We certainly have no time to go back! We: We certainly have no time to go back! We must hurry to the home of the North Elves, to meet our elven allies.
entries.I was born in the Bay of Pearls and spen: I was born in the Bay of Pearls and spent my entire life on the Eastern Shore. But I have spoken with those who have travelled the Western Ocean and met drakes on their journeys. Therefore, I am certain beyond doubt that the creature flying in front of us is a drake, Delfador. Concerning the drakes having never been seen in Wesnoth, must I remind you that we are not in Wesnoth any more? There are many unthinkable things and creatures which can be found outside of Wesnoth.
entries.GRROAR!! Will you silly self-centered cr: GRROAR!! Will you silly self-centred creatures show some manners and pay some attention to me?
entries.No...There is an ongoing civil war among: No... There is an ongoing civil war amongst us humans. The boats were sent by our enemies, not by us, even if they were Wesnothian boats.
entries.I’m glad we agree, Li’sar. Now, onward!: I’m glad we agree, Li’sar. Now, onwards! We must reach the cave.
I’m glad we agree, Li’sar. Now, onwards! We must continue downstream, past these drakes.
entries.Who...who are you? A friend or a foe?: Who... who are you? A friend or a foe?
Unfortunately, we have no other options. Onwards into the cave!
entries.This sounds very dangerous. Perhaps we s: This sounds very dangerous. Perhaps we should retreat to the west, and hide until the battle is over?
entries.I am an honorable princess, not an impos: I am an honourable princess, not an impostor like you! I promised that I would be on your side until we made it out of these lands, and I will keep my promise!
entries.Ach! I understand, Konrad. I am no stran: Ach! I understand, Konrad. I am no stranger to the burden of command. Onwards!
entries.Milord Kalenz! My apologies. I mistook y: Milord Kalenz! My apologies. I mistook you for one of those foul lizardmen. How came you to be travelling such paths?
entries.Lord Uradredia has called a meeting of t: Lord Uradredia has called a meeting of the Council of Lintanir. Rumour is there are greater needs than ours.
entries.What is this? Where are the guardians? I: What is this? Where are the guardians? I see signs of battle everywhere: saurian footprints, elvish blood. This bodes ill for Lintanir. We must hurry onwards to Elensiria. Quickly, before we, too, are beset.
entries.That was many years ago, I’m afraid. Now: That was many years ago, I’m afraid. Now, we really must be moving along...
entries.female^$unit.name| becomes entranced and: $unit.name| becomes entranced and greatly gains affinity with the forest, its nature and ways, and all the creatures within it. She feels she will quickly become more experienced once reaching the surface. Unfortunately, as the last page was turned, the book crumbled to dust.
entries.Greetings, and welcome to our capital. Y: Greetings, and welcome to our capital. You should feel honoured. It has been half a century — a generation in the way your race counts time — since any man has been considered elf-friend enough to stand here in Elensiria.
entries.I might also say that it is you who are: I might also say that it is you who are honoured. It has been so long since you have been graced by the presence of a princess of Wesnoth.
entries.Yes... you are right, sir. It is I who a: Yes... you are right, sir. It is I who am honoured to be here, and I apologize for my discourtesy.
entries.Well, I have the Sceptre! I will return: Well, I have the Sceptre! I will return and the people will accept me as Queen! My mother is only Queen Dowager. The Throne is rightfully mine, and I will rule from it with justice and fairness. I may even accept you as my adviser and counsellor, Delfador.
entries.Delfador, you have raised Konrad to be s: Delfador, you have raised Konrad to be skilful and wise, honourable and just. A warrior who has respect, and appreciates peace. Yet the throne is not the place for him. You know of what I speak, Delfador.
entries.Konrad’s small band of elves had grown t: Konrad’s small band of elves had grown to a massive army. The occasional hermit mage knew better than to interfere with its progress, and soon the plains of north-eastern Wesnoth lay before them.
entries.After spending the greater part of a yea: After spending the greater part of a year in remote, dangerous wastes, Konrad’s heart leapt at the thought that this journey was almost over. Though the greatest danger lay ahead, he knew he was finally returning home.
entries.We are routing their forces! Let’s see i: We are routing their forces! Let’s see if the Clan has had enough. Their help in guarding our flanks would be invaluable.
entries.After burying the little prince, we agre: After burying the little prince, we agreed never to speak of him again. Instead, this orphan child we would call Konrad, and he would be brought up to be king. I would say that I had slain the guards before they had carried out their evil deed, instead of after. No-one would ever have to know. And no-one did know for certain, until now.
entries.You were always defiant, wizard, and no: You were always defiant, wizard, and no-one has thwarted my plans as determinedly as you.
entries.Delfador! You utterly disgust me, you sn: Delfador! You utterly disgust me, you snivelling worm. How dare you confront me, your queen?
entries.... bearer of the staff of An-Usrukhar,: ...bearer of the staff of An-Usrukhar, guardian of the Book of Crelanu...
entries.... Mage Protector of The Kingdom Of The: ... Mage Protector of The Kingdom of The Peoples of The West-North, Chief Adviser to the Crown...
entries.... and personal counselor to my King an: ... and personal counsellor to my King and my friend, Garard the Second, whom you most foully betrayed...
entries.Delfador became Li’sar’s High Counselor,: Delfador became Li’sar’s High Counsellor, advising her in the most important matters of state. He lived until a ripe old age and was granted a royal funeral, after which he was buried in the Royal Crypt in Weldyn.
entries.While often viewed as inferior to their: While often viewed as inferior to their land-loving counterparts, Sea Orcs represent a great leap for all orcs and goblins as they have adapted to aquatic environments. With their curved swords they are competent fighters, although their lack of a ranged attack and poor defence on land do represent strategic weaknesses.
At least I die an honourable death.
entries.Nearby is a clearing with a huge tree st: Nearby is a clearing with a huge tree standing alone in the centre.
entries.female^Should $unit.name| attempt to pic: Should $unit.name| attempt to pick up the sword?
entries.Should $unit.name| attempt to pick up th: Should $unit.name| attempt to pick up the armour?
entries.female^Should $unit.name| attempt to pic: Should $unit.name| attempt to pick up the armour?
entries.A beautiful chest plate crafted from shi: A beautiful chest plate crafted from shimmering black steel, the Void Armour is virtually impenetrable to physical weapons!
entries.Only a powerful warrior may don this arm: Only a powerful warrior may don this armour!
entries.The Void Armor grants the following resi:
The Void Armour grants the following resistances:
blade:  50%
pierce: 40%
impact: 40%
fire:  +10%
entries.My first use for it is going to be to he: My first use for it will be to help us get out of this hole! I hope you consider that wise.
entries.Eldred made war upon Delfador and his fo: Eldred made war upon Delfador and his forces with his mother’s advice ringing in his ears: ‘Fight no-one great or small except the old mage, whose head should be severed from his shoulders.’
